mounting.note: Identity AXIS6: native Z=0 is the flange mating face, mounted directly on YRC1000-R01_flange with no extra VCL rotation. VCL SCALE=0.001 is the mm-to-metre boundary for MotoSim and must not be reapplied to these native-millimetre triangles.

tool_data_vendor_nominal.status: Vendor-nominal MotoSim dummy marker from AW-HC.vcl, not a calibrated or controller-taught TCP. Distance from the torch's own native origin (the flange face) is 298.352 mm.

notes: Display-only vendor MotoSim HSF tessellation, not a BRep or a collision/calibration source.
Decoded with the project's general import_motosim_hsf.py reader; the torch's largest shell is far under its 500,000-point cap, so no VTK reduction is used or needed.

Triangles are native HSF millimetres, unrotated. cell_hc.py applies the native-to-project-flange-frame rotation at mount time, the same rotation cell_models.py's yaskawa_torch_parts() applies at read time for the LC torch.
